C1422.title: Monero Hit by 51% Attack from Qubic Project
C1422.summary: In August 2025, the Qubic project led by a former IOTA co-founder controlled more than 50% of Monero hashrate and successfully caused a blockchain reorganization, triggering industry discussion about privacy coin security, proof-of-work hashrate centralization, and 51% attack feasibility. The incident shows that even mature privacy coins can face reorganization, transaction censorship, or double-spend risks when external hashrate organization and economic incentives change. Specific quantities such as a six-block-deep reorganization and about 60 orphaned blocks should be supported by on-chain analysis or source pages if included.
